purpose: Measure actual Hyperliquid Portfolio Margin account behavior and incremental maintenance consumption for a small matched UBTC spot + BTC short-perp pair after CARRY-IMPL-0034 passed public feasibility.

prerequisites.btc_spot_representation: official UI BTC -> HyperCore UBTC remap

scope.account_value_limit_enforcement: manual experimental-isolation precondition; unified balances are authoritative in spotClearinghouseState rather than individual perp-DEX balance summaries

fixed_four_stage_sequence.label: cash
fixed_four_stage_sequence.state: Portfolio Margin enabled; dedicated account/subaccount; no BTC perp; no probe UBTC position above $1 residual market-value tolerance

fixed_four_stage_sequence.label: spot
fixed_four_stage_sequence.state: Acquire UBTC spot only; actual observed UBTC spot notional must be >0 and <= $500 plus 5% execution tolerance; no BTC short yet

fixed_four_stage_sequence.label: matched
fixed_four_stage_sequence.state: Keep the spot-stage UBTC quantity unchanged within 0.1%; add a BTC short-perp matched to the spot economic notional within 2%; no other perp position

fixed_four_stage_sequence.label: closed
fixed_four_stage_sequence.state: Close BTC short and exit the probe UBTC spot; BTC short must be flat and residual UBTC market value must be <= $1 so mechanical spot dust does not create a false failure

data_authority.note: Hyperliquid account-abstraction documentation states individual perp-DEX user states are not meaningful as the unified balance source under unified/portfolio-margin modes.

primary_observables: BTC perp position size and notional
live UBTC spot and BTC perp midpoint
capital_efficiency_gate_rationale: The 25% threshold is a coarse preregistered structural discriminator, not a parameter search. It requires the short leg's observed incremental maintenance consumption to be materially below a near-fully-funded second leg before any PM-aware stack accounting is reopened.
stage_invariant_rationale: Portfolio Margin mode must remain active throughout all four snapshots and the UBTC quantity must remain effectively unchanged between spot-only and matched stages so the measured difference isolates addition of the BTC short leg rather than an account-mode or spot-size change.
closed_dust_gate_rationale: The $1 residual-notional threshold is fixed before any account result and prevents normal spot quantity dust from being treated as a failed close. It is not an economic optimization parameter.
pass_authority: PASS_PM_ACCOUNT_BEHAVIOR authorizes only one separately preregistered PM-aware BRRK + frozen CARRY-0031 stack accounting experiment using the observed capital factor. It does not authorize production, leverage search, weight optimization, funding thresholds, asset removal, or parameter tuning.
failure_rule: If the first valid four-stage probe fails or is inconclusive, preserve the result. Diagnose only API/state/implementation defects. Do not tune the 0.1% UBTC-quantity invariant, 2% match tolerance, 0.50 PM ratio gate, 25% incremental-maintenance gate, $500 notional cap, $1 dust gates, or account structure on the observed outcome.
